entry_points.text: Register native 5 classes plus compat when emulation, always ok.
Cmdline sets thunk-debug ok; debugfs top plus per-CPU 0644 files show 4 counters.
CP routes user only if user-shadow on, kernel only if IBT on, else unexpected.
Parsers set enable and period and size rejecting bad; work re-arms rounded ticks only if areas plus on plus period.

AMD early plus family K8/GH/LN/JG/BD plus cache/node/virt; Zen 17:00-2f,50-5f Z1,30-4f,60-7f,90-91,a0-af Z2,19:00-0f,20-5f Z3,10-1f,60-af Z4,1a:00-2f,40-4f,60-7f,d0-d7 Z5,50-5f,80-af,c0-cf,d8-ef Z6; TSC warn,F15 align+rand,F15-17 spec,LW/CPUID; K8 Hammer/TLB,GH MMCFG/GART,LN dec,JG hide,BD filt+hide.
Slot attrs via shared show and store; show index or free, store binds once, no unbind.
Report reset plus AGESA once via DMI type and len and count and prefix checks; silent if prereqs miss.

exports.text: Classify by arch compat32 vs native; open and exec map to dedicated audit ops, rest native.
Append relocated thunk template at pos, advance by length; skip when uninit or target is thunk.
Detect ACRN by CPU id, install sysvec callback and point time calibration at shared helper.
Cache and QoS detect: per-CPU sizes, AMD leaf count, max RMID and scale and width from 0x0f/1; absent if unsupported.
Microcode ok only if table matches CPU and boot rev meets minimum; recheck Zenbleed per CPU after load.
Sync AP MMCFG to BSP and enable full segment; check firmware ID at boot for applicability.
Null-seg check by build and mode and virt and family plus probe; debug masks update HW on change only; Zen chicken-bit on bare metal; legacy by family, Zen by gen; skip HW writes when virtualized.

hazards.text: Patch max 254B, detect on func align, tmpl size start-tail.
Unexpected CP once-warns user vs kernel with cause, no kill there.
Max 8 areas 64K 60s -1 auto; word scan logs phys plus val clears, once-warn if bad.
Safe key 9C5A203A warns unless F15; Elan clears alias to protect speedctl; OOS MP once-warns plus taints.
Base ok if end max FD00000000 or base min 10000000000.
Enc needs kexec flush; unknown fam warns gen unset; skip HW writes and probes when virt; L3 needs node flush plus local CPU.

Z1 div+FP,Z2 spec/save/bleed,later pred/conf with gated hides; ECR branch/trans if supp, virt off on BIOS; hide RDRAND F7b18 bad 47s0+Zen5 revs perf below 30; hide vsave 18-1F/60-7F trans1024 F15 max 1F; str F10+ timer F11+ MC below F6 TLB F+ Zen 17+; AMD/Auth; bleed 0830107b,0860010c,08608107,08701033,08A00009; Zen5 02,08,11,24,44,60,68,70.

invariants.text: Five audit tables end with all-ones sentinel.
SBF valid iff reserved clear and parity odd, else warn.
Thunk iff post-init, not excluded, preceding padding matches relocated template.
Four per-CPU u64 count thunks and returns and stuffing and ctxsw for debug snapshots.
Thunk and low-mem units use distinct log prefixes.
CP strings fold OOR to unknown; CFI reads 12+6B back, expects 2 opcodes, type is neg imm, target by reg bits, fail-closed.
ACRN acks LAPIC first preserving IRQ ctx; x2APIC mirrors BSP.
Inval limit 1; K6 model and step fixes with 508MB and 4092MB write-alloc under flush plus IRQ off; K7 vectors via cfg b15 models 6-10, clock hi 2 for m8 s1+.
Node search down then up for assigned plus online else first online; start OS and cache id plus correction, try HT by init APIC id.
SNP only if feat plus bare plus recent or arch-read plus firmware; TSA clearing only if ucode meets minima else log; RDRAND only with force.
L1 vs L2 sizing with inclusive and legacy; 80000005 and 06 and 08 sizes, 8000001D AMD vs 4 else until null; TLB FamF+ L2-pref model-fix halved for large; null probe preserves FS, cleared is fast.
EIBRS mode is any of 3 related mitigation enums.
L3 writes need admin, reject occupied and dup and oversize; presence 1C4 b0/4,1/5 F15,8/9,12/13 else; slots 1BC+s*4 top2 state low12 index.

locks.text: SBF IO holds rtc_lock with IRQ save and restore.
Module patch under text_mutex; skip if thunk uninit.

state_machines.text: SBF: read, warn if bad, clear res plus boot plus diag, opt set PnP, write with parity.
User CP: sample SSP pre-STI, log IP and SP and SSP and enclave rate-limited, force SEGV-CP, CLI.
Kernel CP: only endbranch expected; selftest tolerates via clear result plus WFE else warn plus clear or halt; boot picks dis or warn or fatal.
CFI by mode: kcfi validates plus 1B adjust, fine delegates, else no-trap.
Low-mem: resolve tri-state, off if size0, round pages, reserve plus zero free low ranges till full.
ACRN calls ptr only if set; install and remove store and clear unsynced.
Enc: flag incoherence if 8000001F; check FW, shrink width by enc bits, drop caps if FW off or 32b or no mask or unlocked.
MMCFG: honor probe flag; adopt and validate if enabled else discover once via PCI and bridge and top-mem and windows below/above/gap, program or disable.
L3 per subcache armed to committed with node flush, slot and subcache and index, commit then enable.
Bleed per CPU plus global post-ucode: on if old off if new; skip if no vector or virtualized.

structs.text: SBF: b0 PnP, b1 booting, b2 diag, b7 parity, reserved 0x78.
Text range is start, end, name; built-in via linkers, per-module base plus size plus name; 32 NOPs for align.
Scan area is u64 phys plus u64 len array with count.
ACRN desc is name, detect, type, platform and x2APIC inits.
Ucode tables map vendor and fam and model plus step range to minimum, empty end; TSA plus 1386 for 17:01s2,31s0.
AMD dev is vendor and id plus early and TLB and boot and general hooks; debug is 4 u64 per CPU with reg table at Fam16h reg0 idx 0-3.
L3 geom is per-subcache counts plus max index from largest scaled.
Reset is 32b PM base plus off, all-ones ignore, W1C; bits 0-2 therm and pwr and shutdown, 4 off, 9 limit, 16-27 reset and SW, 29-31 hs and parity and flood.
CP err low15 cause 1-5 near and far+iret and endbranch and restore and busy; low16 top is enclave.
Elan base FFFC en b31 key CB.
